top_choice_rationale: The GLP-1 science is mature and independently confirmed, so the choice between P002 and P001 turns on citation scope and allocation. I rank P002 first because a discovery-centred citation naming Holst (incretin physiology), Drucker (proglucagon-derived peptide and receptor biology) and Mojsov (identification and synthesis of the active GLP-1 peptide) rests on the physiology that made the later analogues possible. P001 is a close second and clearly better than no award: it credits Knudsen's long-acting analogues, a strong translational contribution, but leaves out the academic identification of the active peptide. Mojsov's priority relative to the Habener group is unverified from the supplied evidence, which is the main risk to P002.
